user.description: Enter your [eWeLink account]({ewelink_url}) credentials to retrieve local device metadata and encryption keys. Device control and state updates remain LAN-only.

data.username: Email or phone (use any value for DIY devices)
data.password: Password (metadata and local encryption keys only; leave blank for DIY devices)
data.country_code: Country code (leave blank for auto select)

data.homes: Homes (leave blank for active home in mobile app)
